_comment: ComfyUI API-format workflow for LLM64 scene illustrations, for an
SDXL checkpoint - the Illustrious/Pony-family anthro ones
(NovaFurryXL and friends) in particular. The [images] style preset
'anthro-illustrious' selects this file and fills its tokens; see
llm64_proxy/src/imgstyles.py.
Every value the proxy has a reason to change is a {TOKEN} filled
from [images.comfyui] in config.toml (src/imagegen.py
COMFY_DEFAULTS). A node input that is EXACTLY one token keeps that
token's type, so "width": "{WIDTH}" arrives as the integer
ComfyUI validates for.
Differences from the Flux workflows next to this file, all of them
SDXL's doing:
- ONE loader. An SDXL checkpoint carries its UNET, CLIP and VAE in
a single .safetensors, so CheckpointLoaderSimple replaces the
UNETLoader/CLIPLoader/VAELoader trio and {CLIP} and {VAE} are
not used here. Point {MODEL} at the checkpoint - the launcher's
Checkpoint field lists what the running instance actually has.
- EmptyLatentImage, not EmptySD3LatentImage.
- No ModelSamplingAuraFlow, so {SHIFT} is not used either.
- {CFG} matters. Flux runs guidance-distilled at cfg 1, where the
negative prompt does nothing; SDXL wants ~5, and on a model this
eager to volunteer a beast into an empty room the negative is
half of what keeps the picture honest.
{HEIGHT} defaults to 640 against a 1024 width because the C64 frame
is 320x200 and imaging.py letterboxes into it: a square generation
loses a third of the picture to black bars. 1.6:1 fills it.
This key is ignored by ComfyUI - it is not a node.
